policy.execution: Only this catalog is executable through task_runtime.py run-check; commands are argv arrays and never passed through a shell.
policy.integrity: Each runner is SHA-256 pinned. The package tree hash is checked before execution.
policy.limitations: Catalog allowlisting does not provide OS sandboxing, signatures, or external identity verification. Review runner and dependency code before approval. Operational fixture checks are deterministic domain contract examples; they do not run an AI agent or establish skill effectiveness.
